_comment: Single source of truth for regional season windows. Dates are month-day (MM-DD); windows may wrap the new year. 'grace_weeks' = how many weeks past window edges data may still trickle in before a gap counts as unexpected. Edit this file at the March/September checkpoints — nothing else needs to change for a normal season transition.

regions.name: Mexico crossings
regions.notes: Year-round. A gap here is ALWAYS unexpected — investigate immediately.

regions.name: California (South District)
regions.notes: CA harvest typically spring through late summer. USDA reporting often trails the field by a couple weeks on both ends — hence the grace window.

regions.name: Seaport/other imports
regions.notes: Aggregate of all seaborne arrivals (Peru, Colombia, Chile, DR...). Some origin is almost always shipping, so treated as year-round but with grace since the mix shifts.

regions.name: Peru imports
regions.notes: FUTURE — not yet a separately tracked region. Window included now so the config is ready when a fetcher is added. See SEASONAL_INTEGRATION.md, Future Elements.

regions.name: Colombia imports
regions.notes: FUTURE — Colombia ships in multiple flushes with variable timing; treated year-round with a wide grace window rather than hard edges.
